announcements.headline: 2027 Guidance: Growth, Investment, and Cash
announcements.insight: TEEG provides 2027 guidance following Q2 results and index inclusion. This forward-looking update signals strategic direction to shareholders.

announcements.headline: TE Q3 2026 Notice of Results
announcements.insight: TEEG issues a Q3 2026 results notice. This follows the Q2 2026 earnings release in August and precedes the FY 2025 consolidated financial statements prepared with IFRSs.

announcements.headline: TE Enters FTSE Russell Emerging Markets Index
announcements.insight: TEEG shares are added to the FTSE Russell Emerging Markets Index. This follows recent financial reporting and the cancellation of a proposed transaction.

announcements.headline: TE Announced Q2 2026 FS & Earnings Release
announcements.insight: TEEG released Q2 2026 financial statements following a July notice. This scheduled results filing provides standard performance data for shareholders.

announcements.headline: TE Q2 2026 Notice of Results
announcements.insight: TEEG issued a notice for Q2 2026 results. This follows FY 2025 financials and the decision not to proceed with the RDH transaction in July.

announcements.headline: TE to Not Proceed with Proposed RDH Transaction
announcements.insight: TEEG halts the proposed RDH transaction. This follows FY 2025 results in June 2026, indicating a strategic reversal or termination of the deal.

announcements.headline: Consolidated FS Prepared with IFRSs For FY 2025
announcements.insight: TEEG has published its consolidated financial statements for FY 2025. Shareholders should review these results to assess the company's performance.
